body: ## Summary & Context Closes #1487. Eliminates `CHANGELOG.md` serial merge conflicts across parallel marathon lanes and PR branches by transitioning the aggregate changelog writer to an opt-in post-landing reconciliation step, while establishing **`CHANGELOG_WRITES=off` (or unset) as the universal default**. ## Core Changes & Seams 1. **Universal Default is OFF (`CHANGELOG_WRITES=off`):** - When unset or set to `off`, feature and marathon branches do NOT edit `CHANGELOG.md`. - Post-landing wave reconciler skips changelog writes. - `pdda.sh run` skips aggregate changelog freshness warnings in run mode. 2. **Opt-in Landing Reconcile Writer (`CHANGELOG_WRITES=landing`):** - Synthesizes dated entries from merged PR descriptions at landing time. - Embeds exact single marker line: `` at the first non-blank body line. - Idempotent rerun: 0 bytes changed when the exact marker exists. - Recompute on raced push: resets to fresh base, retains qualification receipts, re-runs reconciler once to regenerate changelog entry cleanly. 3. **B1 Ledger Merge Contract (`ledger_merge.py`):** - Position-specific exemption permitting ONLY `` at the first non-blank body line of each section. - Strictly rejects all other HTML comments, unclosed tags, fences, conflict markers, and secondary markers. 4. **Safety & Governance (`wave_reconcile.py` & `hosted_lane_publish.py`):** - `RollbackJournal` tracks created and mutated `CHANGELOG.md` files; aborted runs restore the exact baseline or delete newly created files. - Added `'CHANGELOG.md'` to `EXACT` declared artifact allowlist in `utils/py/hosted_lane_publish.py`. - Aligned distributed documentation and skills (`PDDA.md`, `ROUTER.md`, `express/SKILL.md`, `install-improve-audit/SKILL.md`). 5. **Replication & Evidence:** - 9 manual controls verified and recorded in `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-11-15+GH-1487/` via reproducible runner `run_controls.py`. - `provenance.jsonl` tracks sha256 checksums for all 9 controls and 3 regression test suites. - Double Codex Relay QA: Plan QA Approved (Round 6) and Final QA Approved (Round 4). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit - **New Features** - Changelog entries can be generated when changes land, helping avoid edits to the changelog on every PR branch. This behavior is opt-in; changelog writing is off by default. - PR authors can optionally provide a changelog entry. If none is provided, the PR title is used. - Existing per-branch changelog updates remain available through the `branch` setting. - **Documentation** - Updated project guidance to explain the changelog modes and when changelog updates are expected.

body: ## What `rtl_enforce`'s GH-68 drift check stops emitting false `dependency.drift (0 lines)` events for watched surfaces that are absent at both revisions. - `relay-automation/relay-turn-lib.sh`: resolve surface blobs with `git rev-parse --verify … 2>/dev/null || _x=""`, so an absent surface is an empty string instead of the echoed `rev:path`. Absent at both revs → equal → skipped. A one-sided addition/deletion still emits, with `none` on the absent side (existing `${_psha:-none}` fallback), as `decisions/2026-07-01-cross-agent-dep-conflict.md` requires ("if any surface changed"). This deliberately keeps real additions/deletions that the issue's "either rev" suggestion would have suppressed. - `test/relay-dep-drift.sh`: the existing end-to-end case now asserts exactly one event with real 40-char blob SHAs (the old `-ge 1` hid the bug: the fixture lacks two surfaces); adds absent-at-both and added-surface (`prior_sha none`) cases; the fixture `cd` is scoped in a guarded subshell (GH-177). - `skills/1-hourly/relay-automation/relay-pkg.tar.gz`: regenerated with `make-pkg.sh` (relay-pkg-freshness). Closes #1049. Blast radius: `relay-turn-lib.sh` is sourced by every relay turn (containment kernel); the change is confined to the warn-only drift block, and the no-change path is unchanged. Attempt 1 (codex build `f64bc2ba4`, claude-approved) failed the classified gate on two real findings: stale relay package (missing from the prepared artifacts, a preparation gap) and an unguarded fixture `cd` (`mktemp-trap-guard`). The contract was corrected in scope (artifact added, evidence recorded in the capture doc's "Correction after attempt 1" section), then `jog retry-build` dispatched attempt 2. - Attempt 2: codex `e546a02fa`, independent claude reviewer approved (attestation `5fe588b11`); `bash validate.sh --auto development` tier 3 full **408/408**; Jog published receipts `5a2d1e09` (`TESTS-RESULTS/2026-11-16+GH-1049/jog/gh1049-exec2/`). `relay-self-sufficiency.sh` was skipped via `RELAY_SELF_SUFFICIENCY_SKIP=1` (live agy provider, quota exhausted). - This PR was opened by the outer-loop agent from the receipt's branch: retry-build reuses the existing lane, so Marathon did not re-cut it and opened no PR (Jog parked it "awaiting-landing … open one from the receipt's branches"). - The capture doc is `roadmap_exempt: true` because its roadmap row lives on the isolated experiment ledger, not development. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? body: ## What changed **Reviewer protocol text.** Next to the existing rule "A `[Blocker]` must cite an observed failure", the relay scaffold (`relay-automation/new-relay.sh`) now carries the operator's sentence verbatim: "A finding from an earlier round stays open, and the verdict stays failing, until new evidence closes it." The three mirrors of that rule got the same sentence: the marathon brief's step 4c (`utils/py/marathon_drive.py`) and the relay and relay-xyz skills. **Driver-run gate.** When `MARATHON_REVIEWER_GATE_CMD` is set, `relay_drive.py` no longer decides on the reviewer's own `gate run: yes` line (GH-1428). On a reviewer Approved it runs that command itself, in the target checkout, through the existing `gate_env.gate_env()` scrub and `proc_group.run_bounded` (own process group, 900-second cap, exit 124 on timeout). It logs `relay-drive: driver-run gate … exit ` on stderr and, on a green run, records `gate_cmd` and `gate_exit` in the attestation record and `driver-gate: exit 0 — ` in the trailer. A non-zero exit refuses the approval: reason `unverified-approval` when the builder's latest block says anything is unverified (the existing reason, same scenario), otherwise the new reason `gate-failed`. The reviewer's declaration is still recorded as `gate-run:`. ## Why In a host relay run (BinoidCBD/LTVera-Pandas#981) the AI reviews turned a FAIL with open findings into a PASS with no new evidence, and approved without running anything, relying on the builder's own receipts. A human reviewer caught it. The pipeline owner ruled on both gaps: add the continuity sentence, and have the driver run the configured gate and record the exit code instead of trusting the reviewer. The driver is the only process in a relay that the party under review does not run, so it is the right place for the run. It executes in the target checkout because that is the reviewed revision and where the marathon pre-advance gate runs the same command afterwards. No turn follows a terminal verdict, so anything the gate leaves in the tree cannot trip a turn's containment check. ## How verified - **Manual red control** (`TESTS-RESULTS/2026-11-14+GH-1465/`, real GH-955 builder and reviewer blocks). Base: reviewer declares `yes — exit 0` over a gate that exits 1, and the approval is attested (the bug). Fix, same input: refused, `unverified-approval`. Builder block with nothing unverified and a red gate: refused, `gate-failed`. Green gate with no declaration: attested, with the `driver-gate` trailer, and `relay_attest.load` accepts the record. Gate not runnable (exit 127): refused. Gate that leaves an untracked file: attested. No gate configured: attested as before, no gate fields. - **Existing focused suites**, disposable verify clone: gh505-relay-attest 63, gh681-reviewer-probe-rules 27, gh268 35, new-relay 17, relay-pkg-freshness 3, gh307 12, gh441 18, debug-mantra 17; 0 failures. - **Full pre-push gate** on `4f3569a55` in the verify clone (Python 3.12.14): 408/408 suites, Python layer 21 passed, GREEN in 621s. Two later commits add only receipts and a summary correction; the documentation gate passed on each push. A local gate is self-reported and does not qualify promotion. - No new suite or registry entry (GH-831). The gh681 assertion on the scaffold wording still holds unchanged. ## Limits - Applies only when a gate command is configured. Marathon-drive sets the variable from an explicit, focused `--pre-advance-cmd`; a direct relay-drive run has to export it. Unset, nothing runs and nothing changes. - It runs the configured command only. It does not rerun a browser case or anything else the reviewer claims. - The continuity sentence is a protocol rule; nothing checks it mechanically. - In a marathon the focused gate now runs up to three times (reviewer, driver, pre-advance gate). - A refusal escalates (exit 4) rather than handing the relay back, as GH-1428 already did. - **Open risk (raised by CodeRabbit, not fixed here):** the driver-run gate has only the 900-second wall-clock cap. It does not have the memory and CPU guard the marathon pre-advance gate has (GH-390), and it runs before that guarded gate, so a runaway test could exhaust host memory first. Sharing that guard is larger than this change; it needs an operator decision. - Not exercised: the timeout path, a live reviewer turn, a real host gate. - No RELEASES ledger row was written for #1465; the capture is in `PROJECT/1-INBOX/`. - Bash twin `relay-drive.sh` is unchanged; it has no attestation. Closes #1465 Refs BinoidCBD/LTVera-Pandas#981 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * When a review is approved and a gate is configured, the gate now runs automatically before approval is recorded. A failed or timed-out gate prevents approval; without a configured gate, behavior is unchanged. * Gate results are included with the approval record. * **Improvements** * Review guidance now requires concrete evidence for findings and keeps earlier findings open until new evidence resolves them.
title: fix(GH-1465): relay-drive runs the reviewer gate itself; earlier findings stay open
